title: Sebastian and the Crown
author: Orsen Yarrow
blurb: Oscar Okafor, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
